title: ASKO — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for ASKO.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Premium tier. ASKO is the Scandinavian laundry and dishwasher specialist owned by Gorenje (Hisense Group). Their Steel Seal washer design eliminates the rubber door gasket entirely — the number one source of mold and odor in front-load washers. ASKO products are built for longevity with all-steel construction and Scandinavian minimalist design. The Butterfly drying system in their dryers tumbles in a figure-eight pattern for gentler, more even drying.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers concerned about front-loader mold. European design enthusiasts. Compact laundry needs with premium build quality.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for ASKO:

• Steel Seal — no rubber gasket means no mold, no odor, no maintenance headache

• Only washer brand that has completely solved the front-loader mold problem

• Butterfly drying tumbles in a figure-eight pattern — gentler on fabrics

• Scandinavian all-steel construction — no plastic tubs or cheap components

• Compact footprint with full-size performance — perfect for condos and European-style laundry
